name: GoCardless
summary: A specialist bank-payment network for recurring and one-off account-to-account collections through Direct Debit, ACH, and open-banking payment rails.

pricing.headline: US Standard is 0.5% + $0.05 for domestic ACH, capped at $5; international payments are 1.5% + $0.05.
pricing.assumptions: Public US Standard plan. Domestic fees cap at $5 per transaction. Payment failures are $5, refunds $0.50, and chargebacks $5 only above 15 per month; plans, countries, and add-ons vary.

sellerCoverage: Eligible businesses in supported collection markets can onboard for bank payments, subject to verification and scheme rules.
buyerCoverage: GoCardless supports domestic and international bank collection schemes across 30+ countries, with product coverage varying by business location.
products: Recurring subscriptions, invoices, memberships, installments, and one-off bank payments where card acceptance is not required.

features.checkout: Hosted mandate pages, dashboard tools, partner integrations, and APIs for bank authorization.
features.subscriptions: Flexible schedules, recurring Direct Debit or ACH, retries, and payment recovery by plan.
features.invoicing: Connects to accounting and billing systems to collect invoice payments automatically.
features.paymentMethods: Bank debit and pay-by-bank methods rather than a broad card and wallet checkout.
features.payouts: Collected funds are paid to the merchant after scheme and processing timelines, with faster options by plan.

responsibilities.note: GoCardless collects bank payments; the business remains the seller.

responsibilities.area: Tax, invoicing rules, and product compliance
responsibilities.note: Bank collection does not transfer sales-tax or product obligations.
GoCardless operates scheme workflows and tools while the merchant owns customer and recovery policies.
The merchant defines charges and supports the underlying subscription or invoice.

strengths: Per-transaction cap for US domestic Standard payments
Strong recurring and invoice collection integrations
limitations: Failure, refund, and conditional chargeback fees can apply
avoidIf: Cards and wallets are your primary checkout
You need instant card-like authorization everywhere
